components.text:
Where the jeans were worn
is the pattern of the collection

notes: The inspiration is what wearing leaves on a pair of jeans. Unpick a back pocket and the cloth underneath, never sunned or rubbed, stays dark in the shape of the pocket. Knees bent thousands of times fade to white. Then there is the topstitching, the rolled hem, raw edges and old mends. I did not want to wash these away or hide them. I wanted them to be the pattern of the collection. The last image is a run of indigo shades, which is where the grading of the fabric later comes from.
